state.metric: max(0, MemTotal - MemAvailable - min(max(ARC.size - ARC.c_min,0), ARC.mru_evictable_data + ARC.mfu_evictable_data)); excludes only reported evictable ARC data and Linux MemAvailable estimate
state.action_policy: Thresholds apply to active RAM estimate, not cache-inclusive occupancy. Pause only the largest active owned numerical service at 825GB; preserve existing pause state; require pressure to fall below threshold before rearming after a manual thaw or unit exit. Invalid/missing ARC stats disable pressure actions.
state.limitation: User-level guard cannot impose a machine-wide kernel cap on other users.
